sys_gen_ai_skill.skill_description: AI assistant that analyzes a Food Base Problem record and automatically determines and updates six operational fields: normalized problem type, current priority, priority reason, AI summary, knowledge insights, and recommended action. It should analyze the food problem description, use the configured campus food-service priority rules, retrieve relevant campus food knowledge, and write the results back to the Food Base Problem record. The AI must use the available Food Base Problem data and configured rules without inventing unsupported information.
